messages:
maria: quick heads-up — onboarding sample app keeps spiking 429s during short burst tests. looks tied to token refresh + paginator backpressure.
ajay: ugh, saw this in CI yesterday. js-sdk masks it differently than go. parity gap? :wince:
sam: repro is pretty cheap. run sampleapp with --concurrency=12 and set token ttl to 3s. pager fetches overlap with refresh -> token requests pile up.
maria: exact steps? can we add to repro-suite?
sam: yep
sam: ```
# run repro
./sampleapp --env=staging --concurrency=12 --token-ttl=3
# tail logs
``` 
leo-bot: deploy pipeline: sampleapp/staging #5678 succeeded (build 2023-11-02T09:12Z)
rachel: wanted to flag SDK behavior: js-sdk queues refresh and only one inflight; go-sdk currently spawns concurrent refreshes which flood the auth service.
ajay: yeah that explains more 429s from auth endpoint, not core rate limiter. auth bursts push overall quota into denial.
maria: short-term mitigation: add singleflight lock around refresh in go-sdk and add small jitter to retry backoff.
sam: also add max inflight for paginator calls per user key to prevent unlimited concurrency hitting backend.
rachel: agree. also doc/update sampleapp to use prefetch throttle example (leaky-bucket) — helps smoothing bursts for new users.
ajay: will file two tickets: one for go-sdk singleflight refresh, one for sampleapp prefetcher + docs. pinging eng-ml for auth quota metrics.
maria: thanks. can someone grab owner for go-sdk patch? @ajay?
ajay: i'll take it, plan to PR by EOD. quick workaround for users: set CLIENT_MAX_CONCURRENCY=4 in env.
leo-bot: note: incident-bot detected auth error spike around 2023-11-02T09:20Z — alert sent to #eng-infra.
maria: cool. rachel, can you PR a short blurb in onboarding that warns about token-ttl combos and recommends client-side throttles?
rachel: on it, will add example and link to the new tickets. :thumbsup:
maria: perfect. leaving this thread open until PRs merged. thanks all!
